issue: Eight bounded Pump Fees differential runners read the captured Pump Fees image, the shared Pump/AMM images, the captured config snapshot and the dependency ELFs, then truncated --output with write_text. Passing an input as --output destroyed captured evidence, or replaced the executing runner with its own report.
affected: scripts/fees_donation_create_differential.py, scripts/fees_deprecated_differential.py, scripts/fees_error_messages_differential.py, scripts/fees_sharing_create_differential.py, scripts/fees_external_codec_differential.py, scripts/fees_social_claim_differential.py, scripts/fees_initialize_differential.py, scripts/fees_sharing_update_differential.py at base; each writer is the last statement of its main block
finding: Base run of the new test: 32 failing subtests in 5 tests. --output on the captured image overwrote it, and --output on the runner itself replaced the module with the report so the same run could no longer import it. Sibling Fees runners (fees_admin_differential, fees_admin_transfer_differential, fees_config_differential, fees_extend_differential, fees_upsert_differential, fees_buyback_differential, fees_social_create_differential) already admit their destination.

change.publisher: PumpReport(output, ROOT, candidate, __file__) built immediately after parse_args and before any image is pinned or case executes
change.report_inputs: the eight runners read only inputs PumpReport already protects: evidence/original/{pump_fees,pump,pump_amm}/deployed.so, evidence/upstream/{pump_fees,pump}.json, research/imported-lab/analysis/pump_fun/config-snapshot.json and the spl_token/spl_token_2022/associated_token dependency ELFs; fees_error_messages additionally declares --baseline as an extra input
change.write: publisher.write(payload) with the existing payload construction, separators and trailing newline retained
change.failure: ValueError: report output aliases an input: <path>, exit 1, before a case runs and before any output directory is created

runs.case_payload_unchanged: base and proposed receipts are byte-identical (no script hash is embedded): donation_create 356 cases, deprecated 80, error_messages 2, sharing_create 116, external_codec 9, social_claim 347, initialize 180, sharing_update 417, all with no mismatches
runs.alias_refusals: 32 refusals exercised by the new test (captured image, captured config snapshot, candidate, executing script); each exits non-zero with the alias message and leaves the target bytes unchanged
runs.publication_control: each runner publishes a fresh nested receipt: mismatch-free JSON, non-empty cases, and no staging file left beside it

tests.before: 32 failing subtests in 5 tests against the base scripts (22.9s)

unchanged: captured images, dependency ELFs, config snapshot and upstream metadata
report schema, separators and trailing newline
not_claimed: The controls prove admission and publication on synthetic local fixtures; they do not re-run the full Fees corpora against every candidate class and make no byte-identity claim about the rebuilt program.
